issue_context.title: Add tests to GA the SET_VAR hint
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Make sure it can take effect as what we want 
- Test a bunch of variables that should take effect
- If one variable is not tested, we will let SET_VAR change it and append a warning to tell the user that the hint might not take effect as expected at that time

review_comments:
It seems that this UT only test the ```set_var``` does not affect the variable. But it does not test whether the variable takes effect in the query by ```set_var```.
So wouldn't it be better to add such checks?
There's no better idea to test each of them at one time. I think we can only pick some of them to test in the way you said.
OK, just a suggestion. (After all, if all the changeable variables are tested this time, the amount of work will be a bit large.)
